records.title: A Survey on Video Captioning in the Era of Large Language Models
records.reason: This is a survey of video-captioning methods in the LLM era; it does not propose or evaluate a concrete inference-efficiency technique for LLMs.

records.title: Domain-Expert-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts for Medical AI: Integrating Data-Driven Learning With Clinical Priors
records.reason: The primary paper applies domain-expert-guided MoE to medical AI with clinical priors and task-specific data; it does not address LLM inference or a transferable serving/compute improvement.

records.title: vLinear: A Powerful Linear Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: vLinear is a linear model for multivariate time-series forecasting and does not study LLM inference or language-model efficiency.

records.title: CREATE: Cross-Layer Resilience Characterization and Optimization for Efficient yet Reliable Embodied AI Systems
records.reason: CREATE optimizes reliability/energy via cross-layer fault resilience and voltage scaling for embodied AI planner/controller systems; its stated objective is hardware fault tolerance, not an LLM serving method.

records.title: FESTAL: Dataflow Accelerator Synthesis Framework with Graph-Based Fusion for FPGA
records.reason: FESTAL is a general graph-fused dataflow HLS accelerator synthesis framework linked to FPGA Transformer acceleration. Its abstract suggests useful compiler/accelerator connections, but no LLM-specific workload evidence was available and the primary IEEE full text could not be retrieved.
